topIssues.title: op-devstack: run the two-verifiers deriving verifier on DEVSTACK_L2CL_KIND and assert follow mode
topIssues.author: einar-oplabs
topIssues.body:
Part of ethereum-optimism/protocol-team#545.

## Summary
The two-verifiers preset runs only the follow-source verifier `c` on `DEVSTACK_L2CL_KIND`. The sequencer and the deriving verifier `b` stay on op-node, because `replaceSingleChainTestSequencer` requires `b` to be an `*OpNode`. The follow_l2 tests also never assert that `c` follows its source rather than deriving from L1, so a regression of `c` to L1 derivation would not fail them.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `b` takes a CL kind. The test sequencer is wired from `b`'s RPC URLs, as `startTestSequencerForRPCs` already does. This covers kona-node as the follow-source upstream (`optimism_syncStatus`), kona-node following kona-node, and op-node following kona-node if per-node kinds are configurable.
- [ ] A follow_l2 test stalls `c`'s follow source (`NewStallableFollowSourceProxies().L2CLOption()`, as the supernode follow_l2 tests use) and asserts that `c`'s local-safe and finalized heads stop while `b`'s advance, then that `c` catches up after unstalling.

topIssues.title: op-devstack: run kona-node as sequencer on interop-at-genesis single-chain presets
topIssues.author: einar-oplabs
topIssues.body:
Part of ethereum-optimism/protocol-team#545.

## Summary
The single-chain runtimes in op-devstack pin the sequencer to op-node when the chain runs interop at genesis (`cfg.InteropAtGenesis`), regardless of `DEVSTACK_L2CL_KIND`:
- `resolveSequencerCLKind` returns op-node when `cfg.InteropAtGenesis` is set.
- `startDefaultSingleChainPrimary` takes the `world.Interop` branch and starts op-node directly.
- The NoSupernode interop runtimes set `SequencerCLKind` to op-node.

The kona acceptance job therefore never runs kona-node as the sequencer of these chains. This matches the behavior before #23947, which made the pin explicit.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Identify what kona-node lacks to sequence a single-chain interop-at-genesis network.
- [ ] Remove the pin once kona-node supports it, or record why it stays.
